# Flygon Flow API reference

38 operations · Releases: `GET /api/devlog` on your Flow server (one per production deploy), also in the app under Settings › DevLog.

Every operation is an HTTP call under the base URL of your Flow server:

```sh
curl -sS "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/$FLOW_ENV/cards" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

Keys look like `flow_…` and carry a scope: `read` (list and get), `write` (create, update and move) or `admin` (keys, sharing and environments). The OpenAPI document is at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. Errors come back with an HTTP status plus a `code` and a `message`. Path parameters such as `{env}` are filled from the input. Any other input is sent as the query string for GET and DELETE, or as the JSON body otherwise.

## Environments

### `envs.list`

List environments

`GET /api/v1/envs` · scope `read` · MCP tool `envs_list`

Environments (workspaces) you own, newest first. Use an id from here as {env} in every other call.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].visibility` | enum | yes | One of `private`, `public`. |
| `items[].owner` | string |  |  |
| `items[].rev` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].updatedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |

**Example: Your environments**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "default-workspace",
      "name": "Default workspace",
      "visibility": "private",
      "owner": "owner@example.test",
      "rev": 42,
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}
```

### `envs.get`

Get an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}` · scope `read` · MCP tool `envs_get`

One environment: name, visibility, owner, revision and how much it holds.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environment` | object | yes |  |
| `environment.id` | string | yes |  |
| `environment.name` | string | yes |  |
| `environment.visibility` | enum | yes | One of `private`, `public`. |
| `environment.owner` | string |  |  |
| `environment.rev` | integer | yes |  |
| `environment.updatedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `environment.counts` | object |  |  |

**Example: Default workspace**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "environment": {
    "id": "default-workspace",
    "name": "Default workspace",
    "visibility": "private",
    "owner": "owner@example.test",
    "rev": 42,
    "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "counts": {
      "charts": 1,
      "nodes": 7,
      "edges": 7,
      "projects": 3,
      "items": 12,
      "cards": 40
    }
  }
}
```

## MindMap charts

### `charts.list`

List charts

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts` · scope `read` · MCP tool `charts_list`

The org charts in an environment, with node and edge counts. `active` marks the chart open in the app.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `items[].nodes` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].edges` | integer | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Charts**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

## Nodes

### `nodes.list`

List nodes

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` · scope `read` · MCP tool `nodes_list`

Cards on a chart (entities, people, areas, notes). Filter by `type`, or by `q` (name contains).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `items[].x` | number | yes |  |
| `items[].y` | number | yes |  |
| `items[].w` | number |  |  |
| `items[].h` | number |  |  |
| `items[].notes` | string |  |  |
| `items[].image` | string |  | Person photo: an https URL or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL. |
| `items[].email` | string |  | Person email, matching them to an account. |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: People on the active chart**

```json
      "x": 320,
      "y": 144,
      "notes": ""

  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
```

### `nodes.create`

Create a node

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` · scope `write` · MCP tool `nodes_create`

Add a card to a chart. Without x/y it is placed at the origin, stepping 32px diagonally past occupied spots (as the app does).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `notes` | string |  |  |
| `w` | number |  |  |
| `h` | number |  |  |
| `image` | string |  | Person cards only: a photo as an https URL, or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL up to 61440 characters. "" removes it. |
| `email` | string |  | Person cards only: their email, so the app can show the matching account photo. Never shared with share recipients. "" removes it. |
| `x` | number |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `node` | object | yes |  |
| `node.id` | string | yes |  |
| `node.name` | string | yes |  |
| `node.type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `node.x` | number | yes |  |
| `node.y` | number | yes |  |
| `node.w` | number |  |  |
| `node.h` | number |  |  |
| `node.notes` | string |  |  |
| `node.image` | string |  | Person photo: an https URL or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL. |
| `node.email` | string |  | Person email, matching them to an account. |

**Example: Add a person**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/nodes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"person","name":"Cleo Park","x":320,"y":144}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 43,
  "node": {
    "id": "cleo",
    "name": "Cleo Park",
    "type": "person",
    "x": 320,
    "y": 144,
    "notes": ""
  }
}
```

## Edges

### `edges.list`

List edges

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `read` · MCP tool `edges_list`

Connections on a chart. Ownership edges carry a percent ("" when unspecified); group edges are grouping only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `node` | string |  | Only edges touching this node id. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].from` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].to` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `items[].percent` | string | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Edges**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "o1",
      "from": "cleo",

      "type": "ownership",
```

### `edges.create`

Create an edge

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_create`

Connect two cards on the same chart. A second edge between the same pair (same direction) is refused with 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `from` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `to` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `percent` | string | number |  | 0-100, or "" for unspecified. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `edge` | object | yes |  |
| `edge.id` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.from` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.to` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `edge.percent` | string | yes |  |

**Example: 50% ownership**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"from":"cleo","to":"quill","percent":"50"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 45,
  "edge": {
    "id": "o1",
    "from": "cleo",
    "to": "quill",
    "type": "ownership",
    "percent": "50"
  }
}
```

### `edges.delete`

Delete an edge

`DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_delete`

Remove one connection. The cards it joined stay. Earlier revisions are kept in the workspace history.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `edge` | string | yes | Edge id. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `deleted` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Delete**

```sh
curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges/o1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 46,
  "deleted": "o1"
}
```

## Timeline

### `items.list`

List timeline items

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/items` · scope `read` · MCP tool `items_list`

Timeline items (milestones, releases, features...). Filter by project (id or name), kind, status or `q` (title contains). Items with start "" are backlog.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name. |
| `kind` | enum |  | One of `feature`, `milestone`, `release`, `deadline`, `project`, `phase`, `event`. |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `planned`, `active`, `risk`, `blocked`, `done`, `cancelled`. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].kind` | enum | yes | One of `feature`, `milestone`, `release`, `deadline`, `project`, `phase`, `event`. |
| `items[].status` | enum | yes | One of `planned`, `active`, `risk`, `blocked`, `done`, `cancelled`. |
| `items[].start` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].end` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].priority` | string |  |  |
| `items[].release` | string |  |  |
| `items[].projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].owner` | string |  |  |
| `items[].link` | string |  |  |
| `items[].notes` | string |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Releases**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/items?kind=release" \
```

## DevOps cards

### `cards.list`

List DevOps cards

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` · scope `read` · MCP tool `cards_list`

Board cards in board order. Filters: column, project (id, name or "none"), label (id or name), assignee (person id or name), agent (AgentFlow agent: cards delegated to it), q ("#12" or title text), hideDone.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `column` | string |  | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name, or "none". |
| `label` | string |  | Label id or name. |
| `assignee` | string |  | Person node id or name. |
| `agent` | string |  | AgentFlow agent id or name: cards delegated to it. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `hideDone` | boolean |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].number` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].description` | string |  |  |
| `items[].column` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].project` | string |  |  |
| `items[].labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].points` | number | null |  |  |
| `items[].due` | string |  |  |
| `items[].assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].links` | object[] | yes |  |

| `items[].updated` | string |  |  |
| `items[].moved` | string |  |  |

| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

### `cards.move`

Move a DevOps card

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}/move` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_move`

Move a card to a column (and position: `index` among that column's other cards; end if left out). The board's gates apply: into Done needs `confirm: true`, or `approve: true` from UAT (the Approve button); out of Done needs `confirm: true`; into Doing without a developer needs `developer` (a person, who is assigned) or `confirm: true` to leave it unassigned. A refused gate is 409 with code confirm_done, confirm_reopen or pick_developer.

**Input**

| `index` | integer |  |  |
| `confirm` | boolean |  |  |
| `approve` | boolean |  |  |

| `card.description` | string |  |  |

### `agents.work`

Get an agent's work queue

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work` · scope `read` · MCP tool `agents_work`

What a runner needs to work as this agent: its `brief` and its queue, the open DevOps cards delegated to it (cards.update agents, or the card's Delegated to picker). Order: doing, requests, blocked, uat, must, nice (work in progress first; Blocked and UAT wait on others), then soonest due date, then #number. `columns` narrows the queue, e.g. ["doing","requests"] for cards it can act on now. Report back with cards.update (checklist, links) and cards.move.

### `agents.create`

Create an AgentFlow agent

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_create`

Add an agent to the AgentFlow org chart. References (reportsTo, supervisor, projects, cards, items) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400, and a reporting loop with reports_loop.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | enum |  | agent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live). One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `title` | string |  | Role, e.g. Research. |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `live` | boolean |  | The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue. |
| `reportsTo` | string |  | The agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level. |
| `supervisor` | string |  | A person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none. |
| `purpose` | string |  |  |
| `instructions` | string |  | System prompt or runbook. |
| `runtime` | string |  | Where it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server. |
| `models` | string[] |  | Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent. |
| `model` | string |  | One model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it ("" for none). Always reads back as the first of models. |
| `auto` | boolean |  | false (the default): the runner starts on the first of models and falls back in order. true: models is a pool and the runner picks one per card. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When it runs, in plain words or cron, e.g. "Weekdays 09:00" (a note carried in the brief for an AI agent; the reference runner does not start work from it); "" for none. |
| `job` | union |  | The runner job it was promoted from: {runner, id} (see runners.report jobs); null or "" for none. |
| `inputs` | string[] |  | What it takes in. |
| `outputs` | string[] |  | What it produces. |
| `tools` | string[] |  | What it may use. |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |
| `x` | number |  | Canvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager. |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `agent` | object | yes |  |
| `agent.id` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.name` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.kind` | enum | yes | One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `agent.title` | string |  |  |
| `agent.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `agent.live` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.reportsTo` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.supervisor` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.purpose` | string |  |  |
| `agent.instructions` | string |  |  |
| `agent.runtime` | string |  |  |
| `agent.models` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.model` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.auto` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.schedule` | string |  | When it runs: plain text or cron; "" for none. |
| `agent.job` | object |  |  |
| `agent.inputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.outputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.tools` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.items` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.created` | string |  |  |

### `agents.update`

Update an AgentFlow agent

`PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_update`

Change an agent's fields. Lists you send (inputs, outputs, tools, projects, cards, items) replace the old ones. Moving it under one of its own reports is refused with reports_loop.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `kind` | enum |  | agent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live). One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `title` | string |  | Role, e.g. Research. |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `live` | boolean |  | The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue. |
| `reportsTo` | string |  | The agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level. |
| `supervisor` | string |  | A person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none. |
| `purpose` | string |  |  |
| `instructions` | string |  | System prompt or runbook. |
| `runtime` | string |  | Where it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server. |
| `models` | string[] |  | Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent. |
| `model` | string |  | One model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it ("" for none). Always reads back as the first of models. |
| `auto` | boolean |  | false (the default): the runner starts on the first of models and falls back in order. true: models is a pool and the runner picks one per card. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When it runs, in plain words or cron, e.g. "Weekdays 09:00" (a note carried in the brief for an AI agent; the reference runner does not start work from it); "" for none. |
| `job` | union |  | The runner job it was promoted from: {runner, id} (see runners.report jobs); null or "" for none. |
| `inputs` | string[] |  | What it takes in. |
| `outputs` | string[] |  | What it produces. |
| `tools` | string[] |  | What it may use. |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |
| `x` | number |  | Canvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager. |
| `y` | number |  |  |

| `agent.live` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.reportsTo` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.supervisor` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.purpose` | string |  |  |

| `agent.runtime` | string |  |  |

### `runners.report`

Report a runner and its models

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `runners_report`

A runner says what it can run, and optionally which scheduled jobs it found (systemd timers, cron, hosted crons...). The model list replaces the old one when sent (leave models out to keep the stored ones, e.g. when a runner reports the jobs of another machine it reaches over SSH), and so does jobs (leave it out to keep the stored jobs; [] clears them). Nothing is saved when nothing changed, so a runner may report on every pass: a report that only moves lastRun or nextRun is not saved either, unless the jobs were last saved 6 hours ago or more (jobsReported); a changed lastStatus, job or field always is. Agents name the runner in runtime and pick model ids; jobs show in the AgentFlow Scheduled tray, where they can be promoted into the org. A job can carry its full schedule: its timezone, every trigger with its raw expression, where it was read (origin, and the repo file), drift from the live schedule on the platform, and a note on conditions its script applies. Give each model a provider to group it by, and billing: included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use), which runners prefer included models by when picking automatically. Up to 20 runners, 1500 models and 500 jobs each.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `runner` | string | yes | Runner name, e.g. Home server. |
| `models` | object[] |  | The models this runner can run (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it). |
| `models[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `models[].label` | string |  |  |
| `models[].provider` | string |  | Display group, e.g. Claude or OpenCode. |
| `models[].billing` | enum |  | included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use). One of `included`, `metered`. |
| `jobs` | object[] |  | Scheduled jobs on this runner (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it, [] to clear). |
| `jobs[].id` | string | yes | Stable per runner, e.g. systemd:backup.timer or vercel:my-app:/api/cron/sync. |
| `jobs[].name` | string |  | Defaults to the id. |
| `jobs[].source` | string |  | Where it is scheduled: systemd, cron, t3, vercel, railway, aside, windows, claude, codex, github or other (any text; defaults to other). |
| `jobs[].group` | string |  | Display group, e.g. "Home server" or "Vercel · my-app". |
| `jobs[].schedule` | string |  | When, in words, e.g. "Daily 22:30" or "Every 5 min". |
| `jobs[].cron` | string |  | The cron expression, when there is one. |
| `jobs[].timezone` | string |  | The zone its times are in: an IANA name such as America/Phoenix, "UTC", or "local" (the runner's own; see timezone on the runner). |
| `jobs[].triggers` | object[] |  | Every rule it fires on, e.g. each OnCalendar line of a systemd timer or each trigger of a Windows task. |
| `jobs[].origin` | enum |  | Where the schedule was read: repo (a config file in a repo; see file), platform (the hosting platform's API) or machine (the machine's own scheduler). One of `repo`, `platform`, `machine`. |
| `jobs[].file` | string |  | The repo-relative path of the config it came from, e.g. services/worker/railway.json. |
| `jobs[].drift` | string |  | How the platform's live schedule differs from the repo file, when it does. |
| `jobs[].note` | string |  | Conditions the job's script applies itself, e.g. "Exits early when nothing changed". |
| `jobs[].command` | string |  | A short summary of what it runs. |
| `jobs[].ai` | boolean |  | It starts an AI agent (promoted as an AI agent rather than an automation). |
| `jobs[].enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `jobs[].lastRun` | string |  | ISO time of the last run. |
| `jobs[].lastStatus` | enum |  | One of `ok`, `failed`, `running`, `unknown`. |
| `jobs[].nextRun` | string |  | ISO time of the next run. |
| `timezone` | string |  | The runner machine's time zone (an IANA name), which jobs with timezone "local" are in. Left out, the stored one stays. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `runner` | object | yes |  |
| `runner.name` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `runner.jobs` | object[] |  |  |
| `runner.timezone` | string |  |  |
| `runner.reported` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.jobsReported` | string |  |  |
| `changed` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example: Home server**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5","provider":"Claude","billing":"included"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 59,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

**Example: With scheduled jobs**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5"}],"jobs":[{"id":"systemd:backup.timer","name":"Nightly backup","source":"systemd","group":"Home server","schedule":"Daily 22:30","cron":"30 22 * * *","timezone":"America/Phoenix","triggers":[{"kind":"calendar","expr":"*-*-* 22:30:00","text":"Daily 22:30"}],"origin":"machine","command":"restic backup /srv","ai":false,"enabled":true,"lastRun":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","lastStatus":"ok","nextRun":"2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 60,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [
      {
        "id": "systemd:backup.timer",
        "name": "Nightly backup",
        "source": "systemd",
        "group": "Home server",
        "schedule": "Daily 22:30",
        "cron": "30 22 * * *",
        "timezone": "America/Phoenix",
        "triggers": [
          {
            "kind": "calendar",
            "expr": "*-*-* 22:30:00",
            "text": "Daily 22:30"
          }
        ],
        "origin": "machine",
        "command": "restic backup /srv",
        "ai": false,
        "enabled": true,
        "lastRun": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
        "lastStatus": "ok",
        "nextRun": "2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "jobsReported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

### `workflows.update`

Update an AgentFlow workflow

`PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `workflows_update`

Change a workflow's fields. `steps` you send replace the old ones (keep a step's `id` to keep it); so do projects, cards and items.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `workflow` | string | yes | Workflow id or name. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `trigger` | enum |  | manual, schedule or event. One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When or on what it starts, e.g. "Weekdays at 09:00". |
| `steps` | object[] |  |  |
| `steps[].id` | string |  |  |
| `steps[].agent` | string |  | Agent id or name; "" for unassigned. |
| `steps[].action` | string |  |  |
| `steps[].output` | string |  |  |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `workflow` | object | yes |  |
| `workflow.id` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.name` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.description` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `workflow.trigger` | enum | yes | One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `workflow.schedule` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.steps` | object[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.items` | string[] | yes |  |
| `workflow.created` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.updated` | string |  |  |

**Example: Pause it**

```sh
curl -sS -X PATCH "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/workflows/Ship%20a%20card" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"status":"paused"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 60,
  "workflow": {
    "id": "w1",
    "name": "Ship a card",
    "description": "",
    "status": "paused",
    "trigger": "event",
    "schedule": "A card enters Doing",
    "steps": [
      {
        "id": "s1",
        "agent": "a1",
        "action": "Research the approach",
        "output": "Notes on the card"
      }
    ],
    "projects": [
      "p1"
    ],
    "cards": [],
    "items": [],
    "created": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "updated": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

## Search

### `search`

Search an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/search` · scope `read` · MCP tool `search`

Case-insensitive search over chart nodes (name, notes), projects, timeline items (title, notes), cards (#number, title, description), AgentFlow agents (name, role, purpose) and workflows (name, description). `types` narrows it (comma-separated in a query string).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `q` | string | yes |  |
| `types` | enum[] |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `node`, `project`, `item`, `card`, `agent`, `workflow`. |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].chart` | string |  |  |
| `items[].number` | integer |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Sign-up**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/search?q=sign-up" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "card",
      "id": "k1",
      "title": "Build sign-up form",
      "number": 12
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```
